```{r setup}
library(knitr)
opts_chunk$set(fig.align = "center", dpi = 150)

proj <- Sys.getenv("BIODB_PROJ_UPDATED", unset = "")
if (proj == "" || !dir.exists(proj)) proj <- getwd()
cfg <- yaml::read_yaml(file.path(proj, "config", "config.yaml"))
TAB  <- file.path(proj, cfg$paths$tables)
FIG  <- file.path(proj, cfg$paths$figures)

rd <- function(f) {
  p <- file.path(TAB, f)
  if (file.exists(p)) read.csv(p, check.names = FALSE) else NULL
}
inc <- function(f, width = "70%") {
  p <- file.path(FIG, f)
  if (file.exists(p)) knitr::include_graphics(p, dpi = 150) else NULL
}
```

# 1. Study design

Two independent bulk RNA-seq datasets profile the **same three EGFR-mutant NSCLC cell lines**
(PC9, H1975, HCC827) under osimertinib resistance, giving **9 sensitive vs 9 resistant per
dataset (36 samples total)**.

| Role | Accession | Lines | Samples | Contrast | Gene space |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Discovery | `r cfg$cohorts$discovery$accession` | PC9, H1975, HCC827 | 9 vs 9 | Parental vs `-OR` | NCBI raw counts, Entrez→symbol |
| Validation | `r cfg$cohorts$validation$accession` | PC9, H1975, HCC827 | 9 vs 9 | DMSO vs `osi_DTP 3w` | NCBI raw counts, Entrez→symbol |

Both matrices use NCBI's uniformly reprocessed counts (GRCh38.p13), so the two datasets share a
gene universe and the comparison is alignment-harmonised by construction.

**Label policy:** sensitive = parental / DMSO; resistant = `-OR` / osimertinib DTP 3 weeks.
Acute 24 h exposure, short/long washout and shRNA/perturbation samples are **excluded**.

# 2. Differential expression (DESeq2 design `~ cell_line + condition`)

Per-cohort DEGs (FDR < `r cfg$deg$fdr`, |log2FC| > `r cfg$deg$lfc`), cell line included in the
design to block the three genetic backgrounds.

```{r deg-counts}
for (acc in c(cfg$cohorts$discovery$accession, cfg$cohorts$validation$accession)) {
  sig <- rd(paste0(acc, "_DEG_significant.csv"))
  if (!is.null(sig)) cat(acc, ":", nrow(sig), "DEGs\n")
}
```

```{r deg-volcano, results='asis'}
for (acc in c(cfg$cohorts$discovery$accession, cfg$cohorts$validation$accession)) {
  f <- inc(paste0(acc, "_volcano.png")); if (!is.null(f)) print(f)
}
```

# 3. Cross-dataset validation

Genes significant in **both** datasets with a **consistent direction** define the validated
resistance signature (the proposal's primary cross-dataset criterion).

```{r cross-dataset}
val <- rd("validated_DEGs.csv")
ov  <- rd("cross_DEG_overlap.csv")
if (!is.null(ov)) cat("Discovery DEGs:", sum(ov$reg_disc != ""), "| Validation DEGs:", sum(ov$reg_val != ""), "\n")
if (!is.null(val)) cat("VALIDATED DEGs (both, consistent):", nrow(val), "\n")
```

```{r cross-figs, results='asis'}
f <- inc("cross_DEG_overlap_upset.png"); if (!is.null(f)) print(f)
f <- inc("cross_DEG_overlap_bar.png"); if (!is.null(f)) print(f)
f <- inc("cross_DEG_lfc.png");  if (!is.null(f)) print(f)
```

Top validated genes:

```{r validated-table}
if (!is.null(val)) {
  kable(head(val[, c("gene","lfc_disc","lfc_val","reg_disc","reg_val")], 15), digits = 3)
} else kable(data.frame(note = "validated_DEGs.csv not found — run Phase 3."))
```

# 3b. Functional enrichment (Stage 5)

GO-BP (Enrichr GMT), KEGG and Reactome over-representation (hypergeometric + BH FDR) run on the
DEG lists in symbol space; pre-ranked GSEA uses signed log2FC as the rank metric.

```{r enrichment-ora}
src <- c("GO_BP", "KEGG", "Reactome")
e <- lapply(paste0("enrichment_validated_", src, ".csv"), rd)
names(e) <- src
for (s in src) {
  if (!is.null(e[[s]])) {
    top <- head(e[[s]][order(e[[s]]$padj), c("term_name", "overlap", "set_size", "fold_enrichment", "padj")], 6)
    cat("\n**Validated signature —", s, "— top 6 by BH:**\n\n")
    print(kable(top, digits = 3))
  }
}
if (all(vapply(e, is.null, TRUE))) cat("enrichment_validated_*.csv not found — run Stage 5.\n")
```

```{r enrichment-figs, results='asis'}
for (s in src) { f <- inc(paste0("enrichment_validated_", s, "_dotplot.png")); if (!is.null(f)) print(f) }
```

```{r enrichment-gsea}
for (acc in c(cfg$cohorts$discovery$accession, cfg$cohorts$validation$accession)) {
  g <- rd(paste0("gsea_", acc, "_KEGG.csv"))
  if (!is.null(g)) {
    cat("\n**GSEA -", acc, "- top 5 by BH:**\n\n")
    print(kable(head(g[order(g$padj), c("term_name", "NES", "padj")], 5), digits = 3))
  }
}
```

```{r gsea-figs, results='asis'}
for (acc in c(cfg$cohorts$discovery$accession, cfg$cohorts$validation$accession)) {
  f <- inc(paste0("gsea_", acc, "_KEGG.png")); if (!is.null(f)) print(f)
}
```

**GSEA engine cross-check (D3):** the Python pre-ranked GSEA (size-bucketed permutation null)
is cross-checked with R `fgsea` on the same signed-log2FC ranks and the same GMT collections
(memorandum tables `gsea_<ACC>_<SRC>_fgsea.csv`). Summary.md reports NES concordance and top-5
agreement; the Python tables remain primary.

# 3c. Sensitivity — biological reversibility (D7)

The validation cohort carries an excluded time-course arm: osi_acute (24 h), short_washout,
and long_washout (7 d / 72 h / 96 h) samples. The locked **discovery** models (persisted per
D9) are applied to these samples after a blind VST refit on all 60 samples
(`scripts/02b_vst_extend.R` — the primary matrix is untouched). No accuracy is claimed; the
question is whether P(Resistant) drifts back toward the parental state after drug withdrawal.

```{r washout-fig}
f <- inc("washout_sensitivity.png"); if (!is.null(f)) print(f)
```

```{r washout-table}
wg <- rd("washout_sensitivity_groups.csv")
if (!is.null(wg)) {
  prim <- wg[wg$model == "LogisticRegression" & wg$k == 50, ]
  show <- if (nrow(prim)) prim else head(wg, 9)
  kable(show[, c("group", "n", "prob_resistant_train_stats", "prob_resistant_target_z")], digits = 3)
} else kable(data.frame(note = "washout_sensitivity_groups.csv not found — run 02b/10."))
```

# 4. Classification (group-aware nested CV, split by cell line)

Models: Logistic Regression, Random Forest, **SVM**, XGBoost (documented extension).
Feature selection, scaling and hyperparameter tuning run **inside each training fold**.

**Pre-registered primary configuration (D2):** Logistic Regression, K=50. Every other
model × K cell below is exploratory (winner's-curse control).

**External-validation headline (D1):** `train_stats` is the headline normalisation;
`target_z` rows are transductive bounds, never the headline.

```{r nested-cv}
m <- rd("nested_cv_metrics.csv")
if (!is.null(m)) {
  best <- m[order(m$accession, -m$roc_auc), ]
  best <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(best, best$accession), head, 5))
  kable(best[, intersect(c("accession","model","k","roc_auc","pr_auc","sensitivity","specificity","n_splits"), names(best))], digits = 3)
} else kable(data.frame(note = "nested_cv_metrics.csv not found — run Phase 5."))
```

```{r nested-figs, results='asis'}
for (acc in c(cfg$cohorts$discovery$accession, cfg$cohorts$validation$accession)) {
  for (suffix in c("_auc_vs_k.png","_roc.png","_pr.png","_confusion.png")) {
    f <- inc(paste0(acc, suffix)); if (!is.null(f)) print(f)
  }
}
```

# 5. External validation (discovery → validation)

The pipeline is locked on discovery and applied **once** to the validation cohort, under two
test-normalisations (`train_stats` = strict; `target_z` = transductive). CIs are stratified
bootstrap 95%.

```{r external}
e <- rd("external_validation.csv")
if (!is.null(e)) {
  e2 <- e[order(e$model, e$k, e$normalization), ]
  kable(e2[, intersect(c("model","k","normalization","roc_auc","roc_auc_lo","roc_auc_hi",
                         "pr_auc","sensitivity","specificity","f1","brier"), names(e2))], digits = 3)
} else kable(data.frame(note = "external_validation.csv not found — run Phase 6."))
```

```{r external-figs, results='asis'}
for (suffix in c("_roc.png","_pr.png","_calibration.png","_confusion.png")) {
  f <- inc(paste0("external", suffix)); if (!is.null(f)) print(f)
}
```

Composite rank combining elastic-net stability frequency, nested-CV selection frequency and mean
|SHAP| (cross-checked against DEG log2FC).

```{r panel}
p <- rd("biomarker_panel.csv")
if (!is.null(p)) kable(head(p, 20), digits = 3) else kable(data.frame(note = "biomarker_panel.csv not found — run Phase 7."))
```

```{r panel-figs, results='asis'}
for (nm in c("shap_summary.png","biomarker_panel.png")) {
  f <- inc(nm); if (!is.null(f)) print(f)
}
```

# 7. Leakage controls

```{r leakage}
for (r in c(
  "Cohorts kept separate; no pooled cross-validation.",
  "Splits group by cell line; all replicates of a line stay in one fold.",
  "Feature selection, scaling and tuning run inside each training fold.",
  "External validation cohort evaluated once, after the pipeline is locked.",
  "Full model × K grid reported; bootstrap CIs included."
)) cat("-", r, "\n")
```

# 8. Limitations

- Only **3 cell lines**; leave-one-line-out CV has 3 folds — results are exploratory.
- The resistant arm is drug-treated while the sensitive arm is vehicle, so the signature is partly
  entangled with acute drug exposure (a confound inherent to both datasets).
- `-OR` (stable) and `osi_DTP` (reversible) are different resistance states; accepted per policy.
- Predictive genes are **candidate biomarkers**, not causal drivers.
